name: Lost Faces.
source:
A horror visual novel about becoming. A girl, born without a face, survives by stealing the faces of others and wearing it as a mask. Explore settings to better understand the lives of the faces you steal.

[From [url=https://n4kn4k.itch.io/lost-face]itch.io[/url]]
